title: Treat You Better

cues.en: I won't lie to you I know he's just not right for you
cues.zh: 我不會對你說謊，我知道他不適合你
cues.text: I won't lie to you I know he's just not right for you

cues.en: And you could tell me if I'm off but I see it on your face
cues.zh: 你可以告訴我我是否離開了，但我從你的臉上看到了這一點
cues.text: And you could tell me if I'm off but I see it on your face

cues.en: When you say that he's the one that you want
cues.zh: 當你說他就是你想要的那個人時
cues.text: When you say that he's the one that you want

cues.en: And you're spending all your time in this wrong situation
cues.zh: 而你卻把所有的時間都花在了這種錯誤的情況下
cues.text: And you're spending all your time in this wrong situation

cues.en: And anytime you want it to stop
cues.zh: 任何時候你想讓它停止
cues.text: And anytime you want it to stop

cues.en: I know I can treat you better
cues.zh: 我知道我可以對你更好
cues.text: I know I can treat you better

cues.en: Than he can, and any girl like you deserves
cues.zh: 比他能做到的，任何像你這樣的女孩都值得
cues.text: Than he can, and any girl like you deserves

cues.en: A gentleman, tell me why are we wasting time
cues.zh: 先生，告訴我為什麼我們要浪費時間
cues.text: A gentleman, tell me why are we wasting time

cues.en: On all your wasted crime when you should be with me instead
cues.zh: 當你應該和我在一起時，你犯下的所有浪費的罪行
cues.text: On all your wasted crime when you should be with me instead

cues.en: I know I can treat you better
cues.zh: 我知道我可以對你更好
cues.text: I know I can treat you better

cues.en: Better than he can
cues.zh: 比他能做的更好
cues.text: Better than he can

cues.en: I'll stop time for you
cues.zh: 我會為你停止時間
cues.text: I'll stop time for you

cues.en: The second you say you'd like me to
cues.zh: 當你說你希望我這麼做的那一刻
cues.text: The second you say you'd like me to

cues.en: I just want to give you the loving that you're missing
cues.zh: 我只想給你你所缺少的愛
cues.text: I just want to give you the loving that you're missing

cues.en: Baby, just to wake up with you
cues.zh: 寶貝，只是為了跟你一起醒來
cues.text: Baby, just to wake up with you

cues.en: We'll be everything I need
cues.zh: 我們將成為我所需要的一切
cues.text: We'll be everything I need

cues.en: And this could be so different
cues.zh: 這可能會很不同
cues.text: And this could be so different

cues.en: Tell me what you want to do
cues.zh: 告訴我你想做什麼
cues.text: Tell me what you want to do

cues.en: Cause I know I can treat you better
cues.zh: 因為我知道我可以對你更好
cues.text: Cause I know I can treat you better

cues.en: Than he can, and any girl like you deserves
cues.zh: 比他能做到的，任何像你這樣的女孩都值得

cues.text: I know I can treat you better

cues.en: Better than he can
cues.zh: 比他能做的更好
cues.text: Better than he can

cues.en: Give me a sign, take my hand, we'll be fine
cues.zh: 給我一個訊號，握住我的手，我們會沒事的
cues.text: Give me a sign, take my hand, we'll be fine

cues.en: Promise I won't let you down
cues.zh: 保證我不會讓你失望
cues.text: Promise I won't let you down

cues.en: Just know that you don't have to do this alone
cues.zh: 只要知道您不必獨自完成這件事
cues.text: Just know that you don't have to do this alone
